The Dragonslayer Challenge is an upcoming esports tournament for World of Warcraft: Cataclysm Classic. It was introduced on 22 May 2024 and will take place on 8-9 June the same year via YouTube and Twitch. Similar to the Undying Challenge, this challenge places two of the top speedrunning guilds, Progress (Gehennas EU) and None of the Above (Gehennas EU), with basic level 85 characters. Day 1 of the event will have the teams run through dungeons and other content to gear up appropriately for the next day. Day 2 will start the speedrunning raids challenge to go through Bastion of Twilight, Throne of the Four Winds, and Blackwing Descent.

The Drake Grotto (also referred to as Drake's Grotto and Forgotten Grotto) is an area located in northern Thaldraszus, just west of Algeth'ar Academy and the Chittering Caverns. It consists of a large cave and the cliffside surrounding its entrance. The exterior is home to a variety of wildlife, including ohuna, argali, and proto-dragons, and features a small Dragonscale Expedition camp. When Not Mushroom For Error is available, climbing gear can be found here. There are two entrances to the cave: one is always accessible, and one is blocked by a rock wall that requires mining or an EZ-Thro Primal Deconstruction Charge to open.
